Dear Mr. Orlebeke:
Referenced document has been received by the Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Environmental Affairs for review and distribution to agencies within the Department of Commerce.
In order to insure adequate time for evaluation by these appropriate components, we require an extension of the deadline for receipt of comments until the date given below:
May 21, 1971.
Sincerely,
Sidney R. Galler
Deputy Assistant Secretary for Environmental Affairs
